inspection_commands: npm view free-coding-models name version description homepage repository.url license bin dist-tags versions time.modified --json

observed_upstream_state.readme_update_flow_claim: Web UI has an update chip/popover and polls every 5 minutes.
observed_upstream_state.release_workflow_shape: On push to main or workflow_dispatch, compares package.json version against tags; if no tag exists, publishes to npm, creates GitHub release from changelog/vX.Y.Z.md, and can attach SBOM.

release_pattern_notes: Recent GitHub releases/tags are frequent; the latest inspected releases include v0.5.39, v0.5.38, v0.5.37, v0.5.36, v0.5.35, v0.5.34, v0.5.32, v0.5.31, v0.5.30, v0.5.29, v0.5.28, and v0.5.27.

Release notes contain catalog churn, provider/model additions, removals from free tiers, context-window/tier corrections, router priority/scoring behavior, probe/failover hardening, and provider-specific schema normalizers.
Per-version changelog files exist under changelog/vX.Y.Z.md and are used by the release workflow for GitHub release notes.
The upstream package includes self-update logic against npm latest; PM should not inherit that behavior directly without a PM-owned update policy.
latest_release_v0_5_39_summary: Removed 11 OpenRouter models no longer on free tier.
Corrected context windows and tiers for several OpenRouter/Cloudflare models.
pm_design_implications: Represent user-facing provider as one PM direct provider named Free Models while retaining upstream subprovider/auth/quota/source metadata.
Separate low-risk catalog metadata imports from higher-risk runtime behavior changes.
Record upstream version, tag, SHA, npm timestamp, release/changelog text, source file hashes, and PM import disposition for every import.
Do not import upstream telemetry, credential storage, self-update, local daemon, or external tool config writing behavior without explicit PM-owned design.
